description.value: inBtwn Cafe is a small waterfront coffee shop situated steps from Vancouver's iconic seawall, offering locally sourced espresso drinks, house-made sweet treats and savoury bites, and gelato, with the walls decorated by local artist Wade's paintings. The cafe's tiny curbside patio faces directly across False Creek toward Granville Island, making it a natural pause point for cyclists riding the seawall. Pets are welcome.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 7m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 77m; stands (7 spaces) at 100m. Total: 21 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM address (1625 Hornby Street, Vancouver, BC V6Z 2M2) and phone number (604-568-0971). The site confirms active operation, a waterfront location steps from the seawall, and explicitly lists gluten-free and vegan menu items. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere in the website content, so those fields are left null per evidence-only policy.
concerns: Website email (inbtwn@shaw.ca) is present on the website but absent from OSM tags — consider adding to OSM record.
Bike parking and washroom availability could not be confirmed from website content; on-site verification recommended before publishing listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active cafe directly on the Vancouver seawall cycling corridor, confirmed open, with food and drink relevant to touring cyclists; warrants inclusion pending on-site verification of bike parking and washroom access.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'GLUTEN FREE (GF) and VEGAN (V) OPTIONS available in our daily rotation'; specific items listed include Coconut Cookie (GF), Energy Bites (GF/V), Berry Oat Bar (GF/V), and gluten-free bread available on request
